P1a_identidade.criterio: features_raw[:,0] == dem.x[:,0] of the _gpu.pt, exact equality, 16 cells

P1b_constantes.criterio: elev_mean and elev_std equal bit for bit in the 4 _gpu.pt of each city

P1c0_cobertura.criterio: disjoint quadrants and sum of nodes == H*W of raster_meta['dem_shape']; recorded

P1c_momentos.criterio: only if P1c0 passes: weighted mean in [-1e-3,1e-3], aggregate SD ddof0 in [0.999;1.001]; otherwise 'not applicable'

P1d_nodata.criterio: share of nodes with |features_raw[:,0]| < 1e-6 per city <= 1 %; otherwise abort

P3_particao.criterio: n_test per draw == fase5/_parcial_laco/<cel>.json in the 960 draws

P4_ndvi.criterio: share of nodes with features_raw[:,12]==0 exactly <= 1 %; otherwise NDVI is record only

P5_controle_negativo.criterio: median(deff) of the permuted target in [0.5; 2]; outside that range the run is invalid

primario.definicao: elevation (features_raw[:,0]; normalised by city by the producer, (z - elev_mean_city)/elev_std_city), FIXED constant c_ref, all nodes, b = 2 km
primario.CV_d_redacao: dimensionless, invariant to any affine transformation of the target within the cell, including the normalisation by city of the producer

razao_entre_celulas_descritiva.nota: in metres = MAE multiplied by elev_std of the city (normalization.elev_std of <city>_v19_<Q>_gpu.pt; elev_mean does not enter the MAE); SD between cells ddof=1; descriptive, no role in the branches (addendum 1)

controle_negativo_P5.definicao: elevation permuted among the nodes of the cell, same computation

razao_entre_celulas_descritiva.nota: in metres = MAE multiplied by elev_std of the city (normalization.elev_std of <city>_v19_<Q>_gpu.pt; elev_mean does not enter the MAE); SD between cells ddof=1; descriptive, no role in the branches (addendum 1)

b0.definicao: same predictor and population, b = 0 (no buffer)

razao_entre_celulas_descritiva.nota: in metres = MAE multiplied by elev_std of the city (normalization.elev_std of <city>_v19_<Q>_gpu.pt; elev_mean does not enter the MAE); SD between cells ddof=1; descriptive, no role in the branches (addendum 1)

mediana_por_sorteio.definicao: c = median of Y over the training nodes of each draw; S2_U of |Y-c_ref|

razao_entre_celulas_descritiva.nota: in metres = MAE multiplied by elev_std of the city (normalization.elev_std of <city>_v19_<Q>_gpu.pt; elev_mean does not enter the MAE); SD between cells ddof=1; descriptive, no role in the branches (addendum 1)

elevacao_nos_validos_RSSI.definicao: test restricted to Z_i = 0 (~sent of the loop); N_U = valid nodes; draws with 0 valid test nodes excluded (counted per cell)

ndvi.definicao: NDVI (features_raw[:,12]), c = median of NDVI over the training nodes of the reference draw, b = 2 km
